summary: Frontend-only testing of Cartazista Pro 'Etiqueta de Gôndola' feature: logo upload, live preview, store name, auto-shrink of long product name, A4 sheet preview with borders+gaps, and localStorage persistence + service worker registration. All 11 test steps passed.

test_results.logo_upload_shows_preview_and_remove_and: PASS (gond-logo-preview visible, gond-logo-remove visible, .g-logo present in preview labels)
test_results.auto_shrink_long_product_name: PASS (font shrunk to 10px; scrollHeight==clientHeight==17, scrollWidth==clientWidth==346 => no clipping/overflow)
test_results.sheet_preview_overlay: PASS (gond-preview-overlay opens with .g-sheet; row-gap ≈7.56px (~2mm), column-gap ≈18.9px (~5mm); .g-label border 1px solid black — labels have their own cut lines with visible gap)
test_results.persistence_localStorage_after_normal_re: PASS (after page.reload() the store name 'Mercado Teste' and logo data URL restored on modal open — NO Ctrl+Shift+R needed)
test_results.logo_remove_button: PASS (clicking gond-logo-remove clears .g-logo from live preview and hides the remove button)
test_results.no_console_errors_besides_expected_fireb: PASS (0 non-firebase console errors; firebase anon auth error is expected in preview env — app correctly falls back to guest/offline mode)

critical_code_review_comments: app.js fitGondProd() leaves the label attached to an off-screen measurer (_gondMeasurer) after measurement; it relies on the caller's subsequent appendChild to move it out. Works today (renderGondolaLivePreview and buildGondolaSheetsInto both re-append), but is a fragile contract — a future caller that forgets to re-append will silently render labels off-screen. Consider explicitly removing from measurer before returning.
app.js is ~3000 lines — approaching size where a split into modules (gondola.js, editor.js, auth.js) would improve maintainability per code review guidelines (>700 lines threshold).

Firebase anonymous auth fails with auth/admin-restricted-operation in the preview environment; app handles it gracefully (offline mode) so guest features work, but the console error is noisy. Consider suppressing/logging at info level when guest mode is intended.
seed_data_creation: Generated a tiny 8x8 PNG at /tmp/tt/logo.png for the logo upload flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new gôndola features validated end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. Selectors used: data-testid btn-gondola, modal-gondola, gond-prod-0/1, gond-preco-0, gond-add-row, gond-loja, gond-logo-input, gond-logo-preview, gond-logo-remove, gond-preview, gond-preview-overlay. localStorage key: cartazista_gondola_settings. SW: cartazista-cache-v13 (network-first with no-store). Splash requires ~5-6s wait before btn-gondola is clickable.
